thread:
sam: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands  two short clarifications: product focus and market positioning.

maria: Short answers: focus infra first (reliability/fallbacks), then UX polish.

kai: Can we get concrete SLO targets to aim for this quarter?

maria: Yes. Draft targets: 99.9% availability for hosted, p99 latency targets by model family, and documented graceful degradation paths. We'll publish Monday.

jess: For messaging: should we keep saying 'developer-first' externally? Some enterprise buyers found that confusing.

sam: Keep 'developer-first' but lead with 'production economics for LLMs' in GTM materials.

ops-bot: Reminder: add any items to the strategy doc before Thu sync: https://redwood.internal/strategy (automated)

kai: Are we committing to competing on price vs on observability? Curious for prioritization.

sam: We won't be the absolute cheapest. Invest in Optimize features to lower unit cost while selling our strength: predictable performance and tooling to avoid incidents.

maria: Also: CS and sales will get a Dedicated-eligibility signal in the console next month to help with proactive outreach.

sam: Thanks everyone. If you have follow-ups, drop them here and we'll fold into the playbook. :white_check_mark:
